acquisition method: operated in standard data-dependent acquisition mode
alkylation reagent: The free thiols were then alkylated with freshly prepared iodoacetamide
alkylation concentration: added to give 10 mM final concentration
cleavage agent: Trypsin/Lys-C Mix (V5071, Promega, Madison, WI) was added
collision energy: two collision energies toggled between 25 and 30%
instrument: analyzed on-line by using a Q-Exactive Plus mass spectrometer
labeling: The separated peptides were analyzed on-line by using a Q-Exactive Plus mass spectrometer
precursor tolerance: Search parameters included a precursor-ion mass tolerance of 10.0 ppm... Byonic searches employed the same database but used a precursor ion mass tolerance of 20 ppm
fragment tolerance: fragment-ion mass tolerance of 0.02 Da... Byonic searches employed the same database but used a... fragment ion mass tolerance of 60 ppm
ptm: all built-in modifications; phycobiliprotein specific PTMs; phycocyanobilin; phycoerythrin
Variable modifications included all built-in modifications as well as phycobiliprotein specific PTMs, and the pigments selected were phycocyanobilin and phycoerythrin.
reduction reagent: disulfide bonds were reduced using TCEP, tris(2-carboxyethyl) phosphine
reduction concentration: TCEP, tris(2-carboxyethyl) phosphine (C4706, Sigma, St. Louis, MO) at 5 mM total concentration for 30 min.
